name: quickbooks-expense-categorizer
description: Scans uncategorized QuickBooks Online expenses and bank feeds, matches receipts and invoice context, and stages categorized entries with confidence scoring for 1-click batch review.

scripts.build:app: bun build apps/expense-reviewer/src/main.tsx --outdir apps/expense-reviewer/dist --target browser --format esm --jsx-factory=h --jsx-fragment=Fragment --jsx-import-source=preact
